title: Call center
description: The call center's web app: how long its calls take and where the time goes (their internet vs main + the store), card steps and failures before the store, the live stream, and which versions the browsers run.

links.title: Efficiency over time (1 year, per version)
links.tooltip: Keys, chords, searches, undo, right-click, items by how found, time per step and order, per agent and app version, kept 1 year

panels.title: Browsers open
panels.description: Call-center browsers that sent their numbers in the last 5 minutes (a browser reports once a minute while open).

targets.expr: sum(callcenter_browsers{deployment_environment="$env"})

panels.title: On an old version
panels.description: Browsers still running a build older than the server (opened before the last deploy). They reload by themselves at the first quiet moment; the top bar shows New version · Reload until then.

targets.expr: sum(callcenter_browsers{deployment_environment="$env", stale="yes"}) or vector(0)

panels.title: Round trip p95
panels.description: A browser's whole wait for an answer (click to answer), every call but the live stream, over the selected range.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le) (((max_over_time(callcenter_client_request_duration_milliseconds_bucket{deployment_environment="$env", route!~".* events"}[$__range]) unless callcenter_client_request_duration_milliseconds_bucket{deployment_environment="$env", route!~".* events"} offset $__range) or increase(callcenter_client_request_duration_milliseconds_bucket{deployment_environment="$env", route!~".* events"}[$__range]))))

panels.title: Their internet p95
panels.description: The part of the round trip that is the call center's own internet (round trip minus main + the store). High here and low on the next tile = the problem is on their side.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le) (((max_over_time(callcenter_client_network_duration_milliseconds_bucket{deployment_environment="$env"}[$__range]) unless callcenter_client_network_duration_milliseconds_bucket{deployment_environment="$env"} offset $__range) or increase(callcenter_client_network_duration_milliseconds_bucket{deployment_environment="$env"}[$__range]))))

panels.title: main + store p95
panels.description: Our server's call to main and the store's Pi behind it.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le) (((max_over_time(callcenter_upstream_duration_milliseconds_bucket{deployment_environment="$env"}[$__range]) unless callcenter_upstream_duration_milliseconds_bucket{deployment_environment="$env"} offset $__range) or increase(callcenter_upstream_duration_milliseconds_bucket{deployment_environment="$env"}[$__range]))))

panels.title: Card fails before the store
panels.description: Card attempts that never reached the store's charge (the card field didn't load, details typed wrong, Square's field didn't answer), over the range. Each one is also in the store's journal (card.field_failed / card.tokenize_failed).

targets.expr: sum(((max_over_time(callcenter_card_attempts_total{deployment_environment="$env", stage=~"sdk_load|attach|tokenize", outcome!="ok"}[$__range]) unless callcenter_card_attempts_total{deployment_environment="$env", stage=~"sdk_load|attach|tokenize", outcome!="ok"} offset $__range) or increase(callcenter_card_attempts_total{deployment_environment="$env", stage=~"sdk_load|attach|tokenize", outcome!="ok"}[$__range]))) or vector(0)

panels.title: Cards charged
panels.description: Charges through the store that Square approved, over the range.

targets.expr: sum(((max_over_time(callcenter_card_attempts_total{deployment_environment="$env", stage="charge", outcome="ok"}[$__range]) unless callcenter_card_attempts_total{deployment_environment="$env", stage="charge", outcome="ok"} offset $__range) or increase(callcenter_card_attempts_total{deployment_environment="$env", stage="charge", outcome="ok"}[$__range]))) or vector(0)

panels.title: main
panels.description: 1 = our server reached main's /api/v1/version on its last probe (every minute). The tile's name is main's version.

targets.expr: max by (main_version) (callcenter_main_up{deployment_environment="$env"})

panels.title: Where the time goes (p95)
panels.description: p95 per minute window: the browser's whole round trip, its internet's share, and main + the store. When the round trip climbs, the line that climbs with it is the culprit.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le) (((max_over_time(callcenter_client_request_duration_milliseconds_bucket{deployment_environment="$env", route!~".* events"}[5m]) unless callcenter_client_request_duration_milliseconds_bucket{deployment_environment="$env", route!~".* events"} offset 5m) or increase(callcenter_client_request_duration_milliseconds_bucket{deployment_environment="$env", route!~".* events"}[5m]))))

histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le) (((max_over_time(callcenter_client_network_duration_milliseconds_bucket{deployment_environment="$env"}[5m]) unless callcenter_client_network_duration_milliseconds_bucket{deployment_environment="$env"} offset 5m) or increase(callcenter_client_network_duration_milliseconds_bucket{deployment_environment="$env"}[5m]))))

histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le) (((max_over_time(callcenter_upstream_duration_milliseconds_bucket{deployment_environment="$env"}[5m]) unless callcenter_upstream_duration_milliseconds_bucket{deployment_environment="$env"} offset 5m) or increase(callcenter_upstream_duration_milliseconds_bucket{deployment_environment="$env"}[5m]))))

panels.title: Their internet per browser (p95)
panels.description: The internet share per call-center computer (the name given at the store login). One computer high = that computer's connection.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, device) (((max_over_time(callcenter_client_network_duration_milliseconds_bucket{deployment_environment="$env"}[5m]) unless callcenter_client_network_duration_milliseconds_bucket{deployment_environment="$env"} offset 5m) or increase(callcenter_client_network_duration_milliseconds_bucket{deployment_environment="$env"}[5m]))))

panels.title: Slowest calls (p95 per route, browser side)
panels.description: The browser's round trip per call. pi/... calls go through main to the store's Pi.

targets.expr: topk(8, histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, route) (((max_over_time(callcenter_client_request_duration_milliseconds_bucket{deployment_environment="$env", route!~".* events"}[10m]) unless callcenter_client_request_duration_milliseconds_bucket{deployment_environment="$env", route!~".* events"} offset 10m) or increase(callcenter_client_request_duration_milliseconds_bucket{deployment_environment="$env", route!~".* events"}[10m])))))

panels.title: main + store per route (p95, server side)
panels.description: Our server's wait for main per call; the store's Pi answers the pi/... ones.

targets.expr: topk(8, histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, route) (((max_over_time(callcenter_upstream_duration_milliseconds_bucket{deployment_environment="$env"}[10m]) unless callcenter_upstream_duration_milliseconds_bucket{deployment_environment="$env"} offset 10m) or increase(callcenter_upstream_duration_milliseconds_bucket{deployment_environment="$env"}[10m])))))

panels.title: Calls per minute by outcome
panels.description: Every browser call: ok, 4xx (refused: closed, declined, wrong PIN), 5xx (main or the store didn't answer), network (no answer at all: the computer's internet).

targets.expr: sum by (outcome) (rate(callcenter_client_request_duration_milliseconds_count{deployment_environment="$env", route!~".* events"}[5m])) * 60

panels.title: Live stream drops
panels.description: The browsers' live stream (new orders, the store's state): drops per browser, and minutes it was down. A drop reconnects by itself; many = an unsteady connection.

targets.expr: sum by (device) (((max_over_time(callcenter_client_sse_events_total{deployment_environment="$env", kind="error"}[5m]) unless callcenter_client_sse_events_total{deployment_environment="$env", kind="error"} offset 5m) or increase(callcenter_client_sse_events_total{deployment_environment="$env", kind="error"}[5m])))

sum by (device) (((max_over_time(callcenter_client_sse_downtime_milliseconds_total{deployment_environment="$env"}[5m]) unless callcenter_client_sse_downtime_milliseconds_total{deployment_environment="$env"} offset 5m) or increase(callcenter_client_sse_downtime_milliseconds_total{deployment_environment="$env"}[5m]))) / 60000

panels.title: Card attempts by stage and result
panels.description: Over the range. stage: sdk_load (Square's script), attach (the card field), tokenize (Square checks the typed card), charge (through the store). outcome: ok, invalid (typed wrong), error (Square's field / servers), declined (the bank), no_answer (the store didn't answer). code = Square's own (INVALID_CARD_NUMBER, CARD_DECLINED, TokenizationError, …).

targets.expr: sort_desc(sum by (stage, outcome, code, device) (((max_over_time(callcenter_card_attempts_total{deployment_environment="$env"}[$__range]) unless callcenter_card_attempts_total{deployment_environment="$env"} offset $__range) or increase(callcenter_card_attempts_total{deployment_environment="$env"}[$__range]))) > 0)

panels.title: Card steps (p95)
panels.description: How long each card step takes: loading Square's field, attaching it, Square checking the card, the charge through the store.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, stage) (((max_over_time(callcenter_card_stage_duration_milliseconds_bucket{deployment_environment="$env"}[15m]) unless callcenter_card_stage_duration_milliseconds_bucket{deployment_environment="$env"} offset 15m) or increase(callcenter_card_stage_duration_milliseconds_bucket{deployment_environment="$env"}[15m]))))

panels.title: Browsers by version
panels.description: What the open browsers run (last 5 minutes). stale = yes: opened before the last deploy.

targets.expr: sum by (client_version, stale) (callcenter_browsers{deployment_environment="$env"})

panels.title: Server and main
panels.description: The call-center server's version and build, and main's version from its probe.

targets.expr: max by (version, build) (callcenter_build_info{deployment_environment="$env"}) or max by (main_version) (callcenter_main_up{deployment_environment="$env"})

panels.title: Page load and errors
panels.description: Page load p95 (first byte and fully loaded) and page errors per hour in the browsers.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, phase) (((max_over_time(callcenter_client_page_load_duration_milliseconds_bucket{deployment_environment="$env"}[1h]) unless callcenter_client_page_load_duration_milliseconds_bucket{deployment_environment="$env"} offset 1h) or increase(callcenter_client_page_load_duration_milliseconds_bucket{deployment_environment="$env"}[1h]))))

sum by (kind) (((max_over_time(callcenter_client_errors_total{deployment_environment="$env"}[1h]) unless callcenter_client_errors_total{deployment_environment="$env"} offset 1h) or increase(callcenter_client_errors_total{deployment_environment="$env"}[1h])))

panels.title: The agents (C6: is each change helping or hurting?)
Orders taken
panels.description: Orders the agents finished over the range (sent, sent from Cash Out, changes sent), the selected agents.

targets.expr: sum(((max_over_time(callcenter_ui_order_duration_milliseconds_count{deployment_environment="$env", staff=~"$staff", outcome=~"sent|cash_out|changes_sent"}[$__range]) unless callcenter_ui_order_duration_milliseconds_count{deployment_environment="$env", staff=~"$staff", outcome=~"sent|cash_out|changes_sent"} offset $__range) or increase(callcenter_ui_order_duration_milliseconds_count{deployment_environment="$env", staff=~"$staff", outcome=~"sent|cash_out|changes_sent"}[$__range])))

panels.title: Time per order (median)
panels.description: From the first touch on the tab (the first digit of the phone, a screen pop, an edit) to Send / Cash Out done.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.5, sum by (le) (((max_over_time(callcenter_ui_order_duration_milliseconds_bucket{deployment_environment="$env", staff=~"$staff", outcome=~"sent|cash_out|changes_sent"}[$__range]) unless callcenter_ui_order_duration_milliseconds_bucket{deployment_environment="$env", staff=~"$staff", outcome=~"sent|cash_out|changes_sent"} offset $__range) or increase(callcenter_ui_order_duration_milliseconds_bucket{deployment_environment="$env", staff=~"$staff", outcome=~"sent|cash_out|changes_sent"}[$__range]))))

panels.title: Keys per order
panels.description: Every key the agents pressed on finished orders (characters counted, never kept), per order.

targets.expr: sum(((max_over_time(callcenter_ui_order_inputs_total{deployment_environment="$env", staff=~"$staff", input="keys"}[$__range]) unless callcenter_ui_order_inputs_total{deployment_environment="$env", staff=~"$staff", input="keys"} offset $__range) or increase(callcenter_ui_order_inputs_total{deployment_environment="$env", staff=~"$staff", input="keys"}[$__range]))) / sum(((max_over_time(callcenter_ui_order_duration_milliseconds_count{deployment_environment="$env", staff=~"$staff", outcome=~"sent|cash_out|changes_sent"}[$__range]) unless callcenter_ui_order_duration_milliseconds_count{deployment_environment="$env", staff=~"$staff", outcome=~"sent|cash_out|changes_sent"} offset $__range) or increase(callcenter_ui_order_duration_milliseconds_count{deployment_environment="$env", staff=~"$staff", outcome=~"sent|cash_out|changes_sent"}[$__range])))

panels.title: Clicks per order
panels.description: Left clicks on finished orders, per order. Type to order and the F-keys should push this down.

targets.expr: sum(((max_over_time(callcenter_ui_order_inputs_total{deployment_environment="$env", staff=~"$staff", input="clicks"}[$__range]) unless callcenter_ui_order_inputs_total{deployment_environment="$env", staff=~"$staff", input="clicks"} offset $__range) or increase(callcenter_ui_order_inputs_total{deployment_environment="$env", staff=~"$staff", input="clicks"}[$__range]))) / sum(((max_over_time(callcenter_ui_order_duration_milliseconds_count{deployment_environment="$env", staff=~"$staff", outcome=~"sent|cash_out|changes_sent"}[$__range]) unless callcenter_ui_order_duration_milliseconds_count{deployment_environment="$env", staff=~"$staff", outcome=~"sent|cash_out|changes_sent"} offset $__range) or increase(callcenter_ui_order_duration_milliseconds_count{deployment_environment="$env", staff=~"$staff", outcome=~"sent|cash_out|changes_sent"}[$__range])))

panels.title: Searches that found it
panels.description: Searches ended by a pick, out of all searches (the rest were abandoned: Esc, the box left, emptied).

targets.expr: sum(((max_over_time(callcenter_ui_search_duration_milliseconds_count{deployment_environment="$env", staff=~"$staff", outcome="pick"}[$__range]) unless callcenter_ui_search_duration_milliseconds_count{deployment_environment="$env", staff=~"$staff", outcome="pick"} offset $__range) or increase(callcenter_ui_search_duration_milliseconds_count{deployment_environment="$env", staff=~"$staff", outcome="pick"}[$__range]))) / sum(((max_over_time(callcenter_ui_search_duration_milliseconds_count{deployment_environment="$env", staff=~"$staff"}[$__range]) unless callcenter_ui_search_duration_milliseconds_count{deployment_environment="$env", staff=~"$staff"} offset $__range) or increase(callcenter_ui_search_duration_milliseconds_count{deployment_environment="$env", staff=~"$staff"}[$__range])))

panels.title: Undo per order
panels.description: Ctrl+Z / Ctrl+Shift+Z on finished orders, per order: many = something on the screen trips the agents.

targets.expr: sum(((max_over_time(callcenter_ui_order_inputs_total{deployment_environment="$env", staff=~"$staff", input="undos"}[$__range]) unless callcenter_ui_order_inputs_total{deployment_environment="$env", staff=~"$staff", input="undos"} offset $__range) or increase(callcenter_ui_order_inputs_total{deployment_environment="$env", staff=~"$staff", input="undos"}[$__range]))) / sum(((max_over_time(callcenter_ui_order_duration_milliseconds_count{deployment_environment="$env", staff=~"$staff", outcome=~"sent|cash_out|changes_sent"}[$__range]) unless callcenter_ui_order_duration_milliseconds_count{deployment_environment="$env", staff=~"$staff", outcome=~"sent|cash_out|changes_sent"} offset $__range) or increase(callcenter_ui_order_duration_milliseconds_count{deployment_environment="$env", staff=~"$staff", outcome=~"sent|cash_out|changes_sent"}[$__range])))

panels.title: Per agent
panels.description: Each agent over the range: finished orders, the median time per order, and what each order took (keys, clicks, search picks, F-keys, right-clicks, undo). Compare an agent with themselves before and after a change (the version table below).

targets.expr: sum by (staff) (((max_over_time(callcenter_ui_order_duration_milliseconds_count{deployment_environment="$env", staff=~"$staff", outcome=~"sent|cash_out|changes_sent"}[$__range]) unless callcenter_ui_order_duration_milliseconds_count{deployment_environment="$env", staff=~"$staff", outcome=~"sent|cash_out|changes_sent"} offset $__range) or increase(callcenter_ui_order_duration_milliseconds_count{deployment_environment="$env", staff=~"$staff", outcome=~"sent|cash_out|changes_sent"}[$__range])))

histogram_quantile(0.5, sum by (staff, le) (((max_over_time(callcenter_ui_order_duration_milliseconds_bucket{deployment_environment="$env", staff=~"$staff", outcome=~"sent|cash_out|changes_sent"}[$__range]) unless callcenter_ui_order_duration_milliseconds_bucket{deployment_environment="$env", staff=~"$staff", outcome=~"sent|cash_out|changes_sent"} offset $__range) or increase(callcenter_ui_order_duration_milliseconds_bucket{deployment_environment="$env", staff=~"$staff", outcome=~"sent|cash_out|changes_sent"}[$__range]))))

sum by (staff) (((max_over_time(callcenter_ui_order_inputs_total{deployment_environment="$env", staff=~"$staff", input="keys"}[$__range]) unless callcenter_ui_order_inputs_total{deployment_environment="$env", staff=~"$staff", input="keys"} offset $__range) or increase(callcenter_ui_order_inputs_total{deployment_environment="$env", staff=~"$staff", input="keys"}[$__range]))) / sum by (staff) (((max_over_time(callcenter_ui_order_duration_milliseconds_count{deployment_environment="$env", staff=~"$staff", outcome=~"sent|cash_out|changes_sent"}[$__range]) unless callcenter_ui_order_duration_milliseconds_count{deployment_environment="$env", staff=~"$staff", outcome=~"sent|cash_out|changes_sent"} offset $__range) or increase(callcenter_ui_order_duration_milliseconds_count{deployment_environment="$env", staff=~"$staff", outcome=~"sent|cash_out|changes_sent"}[$__range])))

sum by (staff) (((max_over_time(callcenter_ui_order_inputs_total{deployment_environment="$env", staff=~"$staff", input="clicks"}[$__range]) unless callcenter_ui_order_inputs_total{deployment_environment="$env", staff=~"$staff", input="clicks"} offset $__range) or increase(callcenter_ui_order_inputs_total{deployment_environment="$env", staff=~"$staff", input="clicks"}[$__range]))) / sum by (staff) (((max_over_time(callcenter_ui_order_duration_milliseconds_count{deployment_environment="$env", staff=~"$staff", outcome=~"sent|cash_out|changes_sent"}[$__range]) unless callcenter_ui_order_duration_milliseconds_count{deployment_environment="$env", staff=~"$staff", outcome=~"sent|cash_out|changes_sent"} offset $__range) or increase(callcenter_ui_order_duration_milliseconds_count{deployment_environment="$env", staff=~"$staff", outcome=~"sent|cash_out|changes_sent"}[$__range])))

sum by (staff) (((max_over_time(callcenter_ui_order_inputs_total{deployment_environment="$env", staff=~"$staff", input="search_picks"}[$__range]) unless callcenter_ui_order_inputs_total{deployment_environment="$env", staff=~"$staff", input="search_picks"} offset $__range) or increase(callcenter_ui_order_inputs_total{deployment_environment="$env", staff=~"$staff", input="search_picks"}[$__range]))) / sum by (staff) (((max_over_time(callcenter_ui_order_duration_milliseconds_count{deployment_environment="$env", staff=~"$staff", outcome=~"sent|cash_out|changes_sent"}[$__range]) unless callcenter_ui_order_duration_milliseconds_count{deployment_environment="$env", staff=~"$staff", outcome=~"sent|cash_out|changes_sent"} offset $__range) or increase(callcenter_ui_order_duration_milliseconds_count{deployment_environment="$env", staff=~"$staff", outcome=~"sent|cash_out|changes_sent"}[$__range])))

sum by (staff) (((max_over_time(callcenter_ui_order_inputs_total{deployment_environment="$env", staff=~"$staff", input="fkeys"}[$__range]) unless callcenter_ui_order_inputs_total{deployment_environment="$env", staff=~"$staff", input="fkeys"} offset $__range) or increase(callcenter_ui_order_inputs_total{deployment_environment="$env", staff=~"$staff", input="fkeys"}[$__range]))) / sum by (staff) (((max_over_time(callcenter_ui_order_duration_milliseconds_count{deployment_environment="$env", staff=~"$staff", outcome=~"sent|cash_out|changes_sent"}[$__range]) unless callcenter_ui_order_duration_milliseconds_count{deployment_environment="$env", staff=~"$staff", outcome=~"sent|cash_out|changes_sent"} offset $__range) or increase(callcenter_ui_order_duration_milliseconds_count{deployment_environment="$env", staff=~"$staff", outcome=~"sent|cash_out|changes_sent"}[$__range])))

sum by (staff) (((max_over_time(callcenter_ui_order_inputs_total{deployment_environment="$env", staff=~"$staff", input="right_clicks"}[$__range]) unless callcenter_ui_order_inputs_total{deployment_environment="$env", staff=~"$staff", input="right_clicks"} offset $__range) or increase(callcenter_ui_order_inputs_total{deployment_environment="$env", staff=~"$staff", input="right_clicks"}[$__range]))) / sum by (staff) (((max_over_time(callcenter_ui_order_duration_milliseconds_count{deployment_environment="$env", staff=~"$staff", outcome=~"sent|cash_out|changes_sent"}[$__range]) unless callcenter_ui_order_duration_milliseconds_count{deployment_environment="$env", staff=~"$staff", outcome=~"sent|cash_out|changes_sent"} offset $__range) or increase(callcenter_ui_order_duration_milliseconds_count{deployment_environment="$env", staff=~"$staff", outcome=~"sent|cash_out|changes_sent"}[$__range])))

sum by (staff) (((max_over_time(callcenter_ui_order_inputs_total{deployment_environment="$env", staff=~"$staff", input="undos"}[$__range]) unless callcenter_ui_order_inputs_total{deployment_environment="$env", staff=~"$staff", input="undos"} offset $__range) or increase(callcenter_ui_order_inputs_total{deployment_environment="$env", staff=~"$staff", input="undos"}[$__range]))) / sum by (staff) (((max_over_time(callcenter_ui_order_duration_milliseconds_count{deployment_environment="$env", staff=~"$staff", outcome=~"sent|cash_out|changes_sent"}[$__range]) unless callcenter_ui_order_duration_milliseconds_count{deployment_environment="$env", staff=~"$staff", outcome=~"sent|cash_out|changes_sent"} offset $__range) or increase(callcenter_ui_order_duration_milliseconds_count{deployment_environment="$env", staff=~"$staff", outcome=~"sent|cash_out|changes_sent"}[$__range])))

panels.title: Time per order by version (median, 1 h)
panels.description: The proof (the owner: 'fruitful and not hurtful'): the same agents' median order time per app version. A new version whose line sits higher is hurting.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.5, sum by (version, le) (((max_over_time(callcenter_ui_order_duration_milliseconds_bucket{deployment_environment="$env", staff=~"$staff", outcome=~"sent|cash_out|changes_sent"}[1h]) unless callcenter_ui_order_duration_milliseconds_bucket{deployment_environment="$env", staff=~"$staff", outcome=~"sent|cash_out|changes_sent"} offset 1h) or increase(callcenter_ui_order_duration_milliseconds_bucket{deployment_environment="$env", staff=~"$staff", outcome=~"sent|cash_out|changes_sent"}[1h]))))

panels.title: Inputs per order by version (1 h)
panels.description: Keys and clicks per finished order, per app version.

targets.expr: sum by (version, input) (((max_over_time(callcenter_ui_order_inputs_total{deployment_environment="$env", staff=~"$staff", input=~"keys|clicks"}[1h]) unless callcenter_ui_order_inputs_total{deployment_environment="$env", staff=~"$staff", input=~"keys|clicks"} offset 1h) or increase(callcenter_ui_order_inputs_total{deployment_environment="$env", staff=~"$staff", input=~"keys|clicks"}[1h]))) / ignoring(input) group_left sum by (version) (((max_over_time(callcenter_ui_order_duration_milliseconds_count{deployment_environment="$env", staff=~"$staff", outcome=~"sent|cash_out|changes_sent"}[1h]) unless callcenter_ui_order_duration_milliseconds_count{deployment_environment="$env", staff=~"$staff", outcome=~"sent|cash_out|changes_sent"} offset 1h) or increase(callcenter_ui_order_duration_milliseconds_count{deployment_environment="$env", staff=~"$staff", outcome=~"sent|cash_out|changes_sent"}[1h])))

panels.title: Time on each step (median, 1 h)
panels.description: phone (typing the number), account (picking the address / Start), customer_form (a new caller), menu (ringing the items), cash_out (the card).

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.5, sum by (step, le) (((max_over_time(callcenter_ui_step_duration_milliseconds_bucket{deployment_environment="$env", staff=~"$staff"}[1h]) unless callcenter_ui_step_duration_milliseconds_bucket{deployment_environment="$env", staff=~"$staff"} offset 1h) or increase(callcenter_ui_step_duration_milliseconds_bucket{deployment_environment="$env", staff=~"$staff"}[1h]))))

panels.title: An item, add to done (median, 1 h)
panels.description: How long one item takes from its add to its choices done, by how it was found: menu (clicked), search (typed), alias (a store shortcut). Type to order should beat the menu.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.5, sum by (via, le) (((max_over_time(callcenter_ui_item_duration_milliseconds_bucket{deployment_environment="$env", staff=~"$staff"}[1h]) unless callcenter_ui_item_duration_milliseconds_bucket{deployment_environment="$env", staff=~"$staff"} offset 1h) or increase(callcenter_ui_item_duration_milliseconds_bucket{deployment_environment="$env", staff=~"$staff"}[1h]))))

panels.title: Searches: time to the pick (median, 1 h)
panels.description: First key to the pick, by what was picked (choice, size, item, alias, customer, order); abandon = Esc / left / emptied.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.5, sum by (outcome, kind, le) (((max_over_time(callcenter_ui_search_duration_milliseconds_bucket{deployment_environment="$env", staff=~"$staff"}[1h]) unless callcenter_ui_search_duration_milliseconds_bucket{deployment_environment="$env", staff=~"$staff"} offset 1h) or increase(callcenter_ui_search_duration_milliseconds_bucket{deployment_environment="$env", staff=~"$staff"}[1h]))))

panels.title: Keys and chords used
panels.description: Every named key (F-keys, Esc, Enter, arrows, Ctrl+Z…) by what it did over the range, the selected agents. action none = it did nothing there; refused = it said why.

targets.expr: sort_desc(sum by (name, detail) (((max_over_time(callcenter_ui_events_total{deployment_environment="$env", staff=~"$staff", kind="key"}[$__range]) unless callcenter_ui_events_total{deployment_environment="$env", staff=~"$staff", kind="key"} offset $__range) or increase(callcenter_ui_events_total{deployment_environment="$env", staff=~"$staff", kind="key"}[$__range]))) > 0)

panels.title: Clicks by target
panels.description: Left and right clicks by what was clicked (bar-send, mb-item, line-row…). The keys that still take the most clicks are the next to get a shortcut.

targets.expr: topk(30, sum by (name, detail) (((max_over_time(callcenter_ui_events_total{deployment_environment="$env", staff=~"$staff", kind="click"}[$__range]) unless callcenter_ui_events_total{deployment_environment="$env", staff=~"$staff", kind="click"} offset $__range) or increase(callcenter_ui_events_total{deployment_environment="$env", staff=~"$staff", kind="click"}[$__range]))) > 0)

panels.title: Right-click menus, undo and screen pops
panels.description: context: rows right-clicked and the key picked; undo: what Ctrl+Z brought back; nav: tab switches by F-key or click, screen pops (found / not, the choice).

targets.expr: sort_desc(sum by (kind, name, detail) (((max_over_time(callcenter_ui_events_total{deployment_environment="$env", staff=~"$staff", kind=~"context|undo|nav"}[$__range]) unless callcenter_ui_events_total{deployment_environment="$env", staff=~"$staff", kind=~"context|undo|nav"} offset $__range) or increase(callcenter_ui_events_total{deployment_environment="$env", staff=~"$staff", kind=~"context|undo|nav"}[$__range]))) > 0)

panels.title: Every agent event (Loki, scope quicc.ui, kept 1 day)
panels.description: One line per event with all its details (ui_* fields, staff, device, client_version, net_*). The detailed stream (detail="full") is kept 1 day; older ranges: the 7-day digest below. Never a customer's details: the browser sends none.

targets.expr: {service_name="quicc-callcenter", deployment_environment="$env", detail!="digest"} | staff=~"$staff"

panels.title: Network & clock · clocks off now
panels.description: Agents whose computer clock was over 2 minutes off our server's at their last sample (the last 15 minutes). Fix: Windows › Time & language › Set time automatically + Set time zone automatically (Manila).

targets.expr: count(abs(callcenter_clock_offset_milliseconds{deployment_environment="$env", staff=~"$staff"}) > 120000) or vector(0)

panels.title: Round trip to us (p95)
panels.description: Each sample's median of 5 round trips to our server (/healthz) from the agents' computers, p95 over the range. Over 1.5 s = bad.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le) (((max_over_time(callcenter_net_rtt_milliseconds_bucket{deployment_environment="$env", staff=~"$staff", target="us"}[$__range]) unless callcenter_net_rtt_milliseconds_bucket{deployment_environment="$env", staff=~"$staff", target="us"} offset $__range) or increase(callcenter_net_rtt_milliseconds_bucket{deployment_environment="$env", staff=~"$staff", target="us"}[$__range]))))

panels.title: Square from their computers (p95)
panels.description: Square's script (square_js) and card server (pci-connect /payments/hydrate, never card data) from the agents' browsers, p95 over the range. Over 3 s = bad.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le) (((max_over_time(callcenter_net_rtt_milliseconds_bucket{deployment_environment="$env", staff=~"$staff", target=~"square_js|pci"}[$__range]) unless callcenter_net_rtt_milliseconds_bucket{deployment_environment="$env", staff=~"$staff", target=~"square_js|pci"} offset $__range) or increase(callcenter_net_rtt_milliseconds_bucket{deployment_environment="$env", staff=~"$staff", target=~"square_js|pci"}[$__range]))))

panels.title: Failed round trips
panels.description: Round trips from the agents' computers that got no answer (to us, Square's script, Square's card server) over the range.

targets.expr: sum(((max_over_time(callcenter_net_failures_total{deployment_environment="$env", staff=~"$staff"}[$__range]) unless callcenter_net_failures_total{deployment_environment="$env", staff=~"$staff"} offset $__range) or increase(callcenter_net_failures_total{deployment_environment="$env", staff=~"$staff"}[$__range]))) or vector(0)

panels.title: Connection checks run
panels.description: "Check my connection" presses (the ? sheet, the card dialog after a refusal) over the range.

targets.expr: sum(((max_over_time(callcenter_net_checks_total{deployment_environment="$env", staff=~"$staff"}[$__range]) unless callcenter_net_checks_total{deployment_environment="$env", staff=~"$staff"} offset $__range) or increase(callcenter_net_checks_total{deployment_environment="$env", staff=~"$staff"}[$__range]))) or vector(0)

panels.title: Cards tried on a bad network
panels.description: Card attempts whose network sample just before was bad (a failure, over 1.5 s to us, over 3 s to Square), of all card attempts with a sample.

targets.expr: sum(((max_over_time(callcenter_card_net_total{deployment_environment="$env", net="bad"}[$__range]) unless callcenter_card_net_total{deployment_environment="$env", net="bad"} offset $__range) or increase(callcenter_card_net_total{deployment_environment="$env", net="bad"}[$__range]))) / sum(((max_over_time(callcenter_card_net_total{deployment_environment="$env", net!="none"}[$__range]) unless callcenter_card_net_total{deployment_environment="$env", net!="none"} offset $__range) or increase(callcenter_card_net_total{deployment_environment="$env", net!="none"}[$__range])))

panels.title: Clock offset per agent
panels.description: The agent's computer clock minus our server's (round-trip corrected, + = ahead), at each sample (every 5 minutes, around each card). Outside ±2 min the agent sees a red banner with the fix; Square's card box can refuse cards.

targets.expr: callcenter_clock_offset_milliseconds{deployment_environment="$env", staff=~"$staff"}

panels.title: Round trip to us per agent and provider (p95, 15 m)
panels.description: Each sample's median round trip to our server (/healthz), per agent and internet provider (PLDT, Globe, Converge…, from the offline ASN table). One agent high = that computer; one provider high = that provider.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, staff, isp) (((max_over_time(callcenter_net_rtt_milliseconds_bucket{deployment_environment="$env", staff=~"$staff", target="us"}[15m]) unless callcenter_net_rtt_milliseconds_bucket{deployment_environment="$env", staff=~"$staff", target="us"} offset 15m) or increase(callcenter_net_rtt_milliseconds_bucket{deployment_environment="$env", staff=~"$staff", target="us"}[15m]))))

panels.title: Round trip to Square per provider (p95, 15 m)
panels.description: Square's script (square_js) and card server (pci) from the agents' browsers, per provider. High here while our server is fine = the route to Square (the provider or Square).

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, isp, target) (((max_over_time(callcenter_net_rtt_milliseconds_bucket{deployment_environment="$env", staff=~"$staff", target=~"square_js|pci"}[15m]) unless callcenter_net_rtt_milliseconds_bucket{deployment_environment="$env", staff=~"$staff", target=~"square_js|pci"} offset 15m) or increase(callcenter_net_rtt_milliseconds_bucket{deployment_environment="$env", staff=~"$staff", target=~"square_js|pci"}[15m]))))

panels.title: Failed round trips per agent and provider (15 m)
panels.description: No answer in time, per target (us, square_js, pci), agent and provider. Early-morning clusters on one provider = the provider.

targets.expr: sum by (staff, isp, target) (((max_over_time(callcenter_net_failures_total{deployment_environment="$env", staff=~"$staff"}[15m]) unless callcenter_net_failures_total{deployment_environment="$env", staff=~"$staff"} offset 15m) or increase(callcenter_net_failures_total{deployment_environment="$env", staff=~"$staff"}[15m])))

panels.title: Card outcome vs the network at that moment
panels.description: Every card attempt by its outcome (ok, refused, declined, invalid, error, unreachable…) beside the clock (ok / off over 2 min / none) and the network (good / bad / none) sampled just before it, per provider. Refusals with a good network and a good clock = Square or the bank refused the card.

targets.expr: sort_desc(sum by (outcome, net, clock, isp) (((max_over_time(callcenter_card_net_total{deployment_environment="$env"}[$__range]) unless callcenter_card_net_total{deployment_environment="$env"} offset $__range) or increase(callcenter_card_net_total{deployment_environment="$env"}[$__range]))) > 0)

panels.title: Connection checks run
panels.description: "Check my connection" by agent, provider, verdict (ok, clock, tz, offline, us_loss, square_loss, square_down, us_slow, square_slow) and where it was pressed (button, card_dialog). Each is also a connection.check row in the store's journal.

targets.expr: sort_desc(sum by (staff, isp, verdict, via) (((max_over_time(callcenter_net_checks_total{deployment_environment="$env", staff=~"$staff"}[$__range]) unless callcenter_net_checks_total{deployment_environment="$env", staff=~"$staff"} offset $__range) or increase(callcenter_net_checks_total{deployment_environment="$env", staff=~"$staff"}[$__range]))) > 0)

panels.title: The 7-day digest (Loki, detail="digest")
panels.description: What is kept for a week: every card attempt (card.attempt with the clock and network beside it), connection check (net.check), order summary (order.*), error (error.page), bad clock / net samples (+ the first good one per agent per hour) and one rollup.hour per agent (keys, clicks, searches, orders, undos, median times). The address only as its /24 (net_ip_prefix); the provider as net_isp / net_asn.

targets.expr: {service_name="quicc-callcenter", deployment_environment="$env", detail="digest"} | staff=~"$staff"

panels.title: Clock, network and card events (Loki, the 1-day detail)
panels.description: Every clock / net sample, check and card attempt in full (with net_ip, the agent's address, kept 1 day only). ui_bad / ui_reason = the server's verdict (offset, tz, failed, slow_us, slow_square).

targets.expr: {service_name="quicc-callcenter", deployment_environment="$env", detail="full"} | ui_kind=~"clock|net|card" | staff=~"$staff"

panels.title: Items, quantity, search and keys (call center 2026-11-21 events)
Items added
panels.description: Items put on an order over the range, every agent (the metric has no agent label: use the 'Every agent event' log for one agent). Event item.added, metric callcenter_ui_item_added_total.

targets.expr: sum(((max_over_time(callcenter_ui_item_added_total{deployment_environment="$env"}[$__range]) unless callcenter_ui_item_added_total{deployment_environment="$env"} offset $__range) or increase(callcenter_ui_item_added_total{deployment_environment="$env"}[$__range]))) or vector(0)

panels.title: Double adds
panels.description: Items added twice within 600 ms (same item and size): a double tap or double click. A few are normal, a steady stream means the add button feels unresponsive or a button is hit twice by habit.

targets.expr: sum(((max_over_time(callcenter_ui_item_added_total{deployment_environment="$env", double="yes"}[$__range]) unless callcenter_ui_item_added_total{deployment_environment="$env", double="yes"} offset $__range) or increase(callcenter_ui_item_added_total{deployment_environment="$env", double="yes"}[$__range]))) or vector(0)

panels.title: Double-add share
panels.description: Double adds as a share of all items added over the range. Starting guess: under 2 % normal, over 5 % worth a look (marked as a guess).

targets.expr: sum(((max_over_time(callcenter_ui_item_added_total{deployment_environment="$env", double="yes"}[$__range]) unless callcenter_ui_item_added_total{deployment_environment="$env", double="yes"} offset $__range) or increase(callcenter_ui_item_added_total{deployment_environment="$env", double="yes"}[$__range]))) / sum(((max_over_time(callcenter_ui_item_added_total{deployment_environment="$env"}[$__range]) unless callcenter_ui_item_added_total{deployment_environment="$env"} offset $__range) or increase(callcenter_ui_item_added_total{deployment_environment="$env"}[$__range])))

panels.title: Quantity pad uses
panels.description: Times an agent set a line's quantity from the Quantity number pad (item.qty, via pad) over the range, the selected agents. The call center has no quantity prefix to type.

targets.expr: sum(((max_over_time(callcenter_ui_actions_total{deployment_environment="$env", staff=~"$staff", action="qty_pad"}[$__range]) unless callcenter_ui_actions_total{deployment_environment="$env", staff=~"$staff", action="qty_pad"} offset $__range) or increase(callcenter_ui_actions_total{deployment_environment="$env", staff=~"$staff", action="qty_pad"}[$__range]))) or vector(0)

panels.title: Search pick rate
panels.description: Picks / (picks + abandons) of every search over the range, the selected agents. Abandon = Esc, clicked away or cleared with no pick. Starting guess: over 80 % good, under 60 % poor.

targets.expr: sum(((max_over_time(callcenter_ui_events_total{deployment_environment="$env", staff=~"$staff", kind="search", name="pick"}[$__range]) unless callcenter_ui_events_total{deployment_environment="$env", staff=~"$staff", kind="search", name="pick"} offset $__range) or increase(callcenter_ui_events_total{deployment_environment="$env", staff=~"$staff", kind="search", name="pick"}[$__range]))) / (sum(((max_over_time(callcenter_ui_events_total{deployment_environment="$env", staff=~"$staff", kind="search", name="pick"}[$__range]) unless callcenter_ui_events_total{deployment_environment="$env", staff=~"$staff", kind="search", name="pick"} offset $__range) or increase(callcenter_ui_events_total{deployment_environment="$env", staff=~"$staff", kind="search", name="pick"}[$__range]))) + sum(((max_over_time(callcenter_ui_events_total{deployment_environment="$env", staff=~"$staff", kind="search", name="abandon"}[$__range]) unless callcenter_ui_events_total{deployment_environment="$env", staff=~"$staff", kind="search", name="abandon"} offset $__range) or increase(callcenter_ui_events_total{deployment_environment="$env", staff=~"$staff", kind="search", name="abandon"}[$__range]))))

panels.title: Clock wrong samples
panels.description: Clock samples where the agent's computer was more than CC_CLOCK_SKEW_SECONDS (default 120 s = 2 min) off our server's, over the range, the selected agents. Each one shows the agent the red clock banner. 0 is normal.

targets.expr: sum(((max_over_time(callcenter_clock_bad_total{deployment_environment="$env", staff=~"$staff"}[$__range]) unless callcenter_clock_bad_total{deployment_environment="$env", staff=~"$staff"} offset $__range) or increase(callcenter_clock_bad_total{deployment_environment="$env", staff=~"$staff"}[$__range]))) or vector(0)

panels.title: Items added per hour, by how found
panels.description: Items put on an order per hour: menu (clicked), search (typed) or alias (a store shortcut). Type to order should grow search and alias against menu. All agents (no agent label on this metric).

targets.expr: sum by (via) (((max_over_time(callcenter_ui_item_added_total{deployment_environment="$env"}[1h]) unless callcenter_ui_item_added_total{deployment_environment="$env"} offset 1h) or increase(callcenter_ui_item_added_total{deployment_environment="$env"}[1h])))

panels.title: Double adds per hour, by app version
panels.description: Items added twice within 600 ms, per hour and app version: did a release make them fewer or more?

targets.expr: sum by (version) (((max_over_time(callcenter_ui_item_added_total{deployment_environment="$env", double="yes"}[1h]) unless callcenter_ui_item_added_total{deployment_environment="$env", double="yes"} offset 1h) or increase(callcenter_ui_item_added_total{deployment_environment="$env", double="yes"}[1h])))

panels.title: Top items added (menu / search / alias)
panels.description: The 30 items added most over the range (the menu's own name), split by how they were found. Helps the store put the busiest items first on the menu tab and give them an alias.

targets.expr: topk(30, sum by (item, via) (((max_over_time(callcenter_ui_item_added_total{deployment_environment="$env"}[$__range]) unless callcenter_ui_item_added_total{deployment_environment="$env"} offset $__range) or increase(callcenter_ui_item_added_total{deployment_environment="$env"}[$__range]))) > 0)

panels.title: Quantity pad use per hour, per agent
panels.description: Times each agent used the Quantity number pad, per hour (item.qty).

targets.expr: sum by (staff) (((max_over_time(callcenter_ui_actions_total{deployment_environment="$env", staff=~"$staff", action="qty_pad"}[1h]) unless callcenter_ui_actions_total{deployment_environment="$env", staff=~"$staff", action="qty_pad"} offset 1h) or increase(callcenter_ui_actions_total{deployment_environment="$env", staff=~"$staff", action="qty_pad"}[1h])))

panels.title: Searches: picked vs given up per hour
panels.description: Searches per hour that ended in a pick against ones abandoned (Esc, blur, cleared), the selected agents.

targets.expr: sum(((max_over_time(callcenter_ui_events_total{deployment_environment="$env", staff=~"$staff", kind="search", name="pick"}[1h]) unless callcenter_ui_events_total{deployment_environment="$env", staff=~"$staff", kind="search", name="pick"} offset 1h) or increase(callcenter_ui_events_total{deployment_environment="$env", staff=~"$staff", kind="search", name="pick"}[1h])))

sum(((max_over_time(callcenter_ui_events_total{deployment_environment="$env", staff=~"$staff", kind="search", name="abandon"}[1h]) unless callcenter_ui_events_total{deployment_environment="$env", staff=~"$staff", kind="search", name="abandon"} offset 1h) or increase(callcenter_ui_events_total{deployment_environment="$env", staff=~"$staff", kind="search", name="abandon"}[1h])))

panels.title: Search pick rate per agent (1 h)
panels.description: Picks / (picks + abandons) per agent per hour. A low line = that agent's searches often find nothing: look at what they typed in the Every agent event log (menu text only with a pick).

targets.expr: sum by (staff) (((max_over_time(callcenter_ui_events_total{deployment_environment="$env", staff=~"$staff", kind="search", name="pick"}[1h]) unless callcenter_ui_events_total{deployment_environment="$env", staff=~"$staff", kind="search", name="pick"} offset 1h) or increase(callcenter_ui_events_total{deployment_environment="$env", staff=~"$staff", kind="search", name="pick"}[1h]))) / (sum by (staff) (((max_over_time(callcenter_ui_events_total{deployment_environment="$env", staff=~"$staff", kind="search", name="pick"}[1h]) unless callcenter_ui_events_total{deployment_environment="$env", staff=~"$staff", kind="search", name="pick"} offset 1h) or increase(callcenter_ui_events_total{deployment_environment="$env", staff=~"$staff", kind="search", name="pick"}[1h]))) + sum by (staff) (((max_over_time(callcenter_ui_events_total{deployment_environment="$env", staff=~"$staff", kind="search", name="abandon"}[1h]) unless callcenter_ui_events_total{deployment_environment="$env", staff=~"$staff", kind="search", name="abandon"} offset 1h) or increase(callcenter_ui_events_total{deployment_environment="$env", staff=~"$staff", kind="search", name="abandon"}[1h]))))

panels.title: Search picks and abandons by what was searched
panels.description: Over the range: what a search was for (choice, size, item, alias, customer, order) and how it ended. Menu searches abandoned often = the typed words match nothing (add an alias).

targets.expr: sort_desc(sum by (name, detail) (((max_over_time(callcenter_ui_events_total{deployment_environment="$env", staff=~"$staff", kind="search", name=~"pick|abandon"}[$__range]) unless callcenter_ui_events_total{deployment_environment="$env", staff=~"$staff", kind="search", name=~"pick|abandon"} offset $__range) or increase(callcenter_ui_events_total{deployment_environment="$env", staff=~"$staff", kind="search", name=~"pick|abandon"}[$__range]))) > 0)

panels.title: Keyboard vs mouse per hour
panels.description: Keys typed and mouse clicks spent on finished orders per hour (left clicks) the agents spent on finished orders.

targets.expr: sum by (input) (((max_over_time(callcenter_ui_order_inputs_total{deployment_environment="$env", staff=~"$staff", input=~"keys|clicks"}[1h]) unless callcenter_ui_order_inputs_total{deployment_environment="$env", staff=~"$staff", input=~"keys|clicks"} offset 1h) or increase(callcenter_ui_order_inputs_total{deployment_environment="$env", staff=~"$staff", input=~"keys|clicks"}[1h])))

panels.title: Keyboard share per agent (1 h)
panels.description: Keys / (keys + clicks) on finished orders, per agent per hour. Higher = more keyboard (faster for the agents who learned the keys).

targets.expr: sum by (staff) (((max_over_time(callcenter_ui_order_inputs_total{deployment_environment="$env", staff=~"$staff", input="keys"}[1h]) unless callcenter_ui_order_inputs_total{deployment_environment="$env", staff=~"$staff", input="keys"} offset 1h) or increase(callcenter_ui_order_inputs_total{deployment_environment="$env", staff=~"$staff", input="keys"}[1h]))) / sum by (staff) (((max_over_time(callcenter_ui_order_inputs_total{deployment_environment="$env", staff=~"$staff", input=~"keys|clicks"}[1h]) unless callcenter_ui_order_inputs_total{deployment_environment="$env", staff=~"$staff", input=~"keys|clicks"} offset 1h) or increase(callcenter_ui_order_inputs_total{deployment_environment="$env", staff=~"$staff", input=~"keys|clicks"}[1h])))

panels.title: Double clicks per hour
panels.description: Double clicks (click.double) per hour split into double adds (an add that was a double) and all other double clicks, the selected agents. Double clicks on a button that does one thing hint the button feels slow.

targets.expr: sum by (action) (((max_over_time(callcenter_ui_actions_total{deployment_environment="$env", staff=~"$staff", action=~"double_click|double_add"}[1h]) unless callcenter_ui_actions_total{deployment_environment="$env", staff=~"$staff", action=~"double_click|double_add"} offset 1h) or increase(callcenter_ui_actions_total{deployment_environment="$env", staff=~"$staff", action=~"double_click|double_add"}[1h])))

panels.title: Card outcomes per hour
panels.description: Each card try per hour by result: ok (charged), refused (Square refused the entry, TokenizationError/UNKNOWN), invalid (typed wrong), declined (the bank at the charge), other. Counted at tokenize (not ok) and charge, so one good card counts once. All agents (this metric has no agent label; per agent: the panels beside it).

targets.expr: sum by (outcome) (((max_over_time(callcenter_card_attempts_total{deployment_environment="$env", stage="charge"}[1h]) unless callcenter_card_attempts_total{deployment_environment="$env", stage="charge"} offset 1h) or increase(callcenter_card_attempts_total{deployment_environment="$env", stage="charge"}[1h])))

sum by (outcome) (((max_over_time(callcenter_card_attempts_total{deployment_environment="$env", stage="tokenize", outcome!="ok"}[1h]) unless callcenter_card_attempts_total{deployment_environment="$env", stage="tokenize", outcome!="ok"} offset 1h) or increase(callcenter_card_attempts_total{deployment_environment="$env", stage="tokenize", outcome!="ok"}[1h])))

panels.title: Card refusal rate per hour
panels.description: Refused / all tries per hour (7-day digest, Loki): tries = every card attempt event. The refusals from the Philippines (2026-11-22 report) ran about 43 %. Starting guess: over 15 % worth a ticket to Square.

targets.expr: sum(count_over_time({service_name="quicc-callcenter", deployment_environment="$env", detail="digest"} | ui_kind="card" | ui_name="attempt" | staff=~"$staff" | ui_outcome="refused" [1h])) / sum(count_over_time({service_name="quicc-callcenter", deployment_environment="$env", detail="digest"} | ui_kind="card" | ui_name="attempt" | staff=~"$staff" [1h]))

panels.title: Refusal rate by agent
panels.description: Per agent over the range: tries, refused and the refusal rate (card.attempt events, 7-day digest). A refusal sticks to the card, so a high rate may be the cards, not the agent.

targets.expr: sum by (staff) (count_over_time({service_name="quicc-callcenter", deployment_environment="$env", detail="digest"} | ui_kind="card" | ui_name="attempt" | staff=~"$staff" | ui_outcome="refused" [$__range])) / sum by (staff) (count_over_time({service_name="quicc-callcenter", deployment_environment="$env", detail="digest"} | ui_kind="card" | ui_name="attempt" | staff=~"$staff" [$__range]))

panels.title: Refusal rate by attempt number
panels.description: Refused / tries by how many times the dialog had tried (ui_attempt 1, 2, 3...). 2026-11-22: 34 % on try 1, 81 % on try 2, 100 % on 3 and 4: a retry of a refused card almost never works.

targets.expr: sum by (ui_attempt) (count_over_time({service_name="quicc-callcenter", deployment_environment="$env", detail="digest"} | ui_kind="card" | ui_name="attempt" | staff=~"$staff" | ui_outcome="refused" [$__range])) / sum by (ui_attempt) (count_over_time({service_name="quicc-callcenter", deployment_environment="$env", detail="digest"} | ui_kind="card" | ui_name="attempt" | staff=~"$staff" [$__range]))

panels.title: Refused tries per hour, per agent
panels.description: Refused card tries per hour per agent (7-day digest, Loki), stacked: who is hitting refusals.

targets.expr: sum by (staff) (count_over_time({service_name="quicc-callcenter", deployment_environment="$env", detail="digest"} | ui_kind="card" | ui_name="attempt" | staff=~"$staff" | ui_outcome="refused" [1h]))

panels.title: Clock wrong samples per hour, per agent
panels.description: Clock samples over the allowed skew (CC_CLOCK_SKEW_SECONDS, default 120 s), per hour per agent. A wrong clock can make Square refuse a card.

targets.expr: sum by (staff) (((max_over_time(callcenter_clock_bad_total{deployment_environment="$env", staff=~"$staff"}[1h]) unless callcenter_clock_bad_total{deployment_environment="$env", staff=~"$staff"} offset 1h) or increase(callcenter_clock_bad_total{deployment_environment="$env", staff=~"$staff"}[1h])))
